title: Yale Simplifies Smart Home Experience for Matter-Enabled Smart Locks
summary: Yale Simplifies Smart Home Experience for Matter-Enabled Smart Locks
body_markdown:
Yale announced a new update to the Yale Access app that will help users manage the[Yale Smart Lock with Matter](https://shopyalehome.com/products/yale-smart-lock-with-matter) .


Matter is the industry standard designed to help compatible smart home devices work across different brands and platforms, but managing those connections across ecosystems can still be complex. The latest Yale Access update guides users through pairing the lock, helps them choose whether to manage the lock through Yale Access or connect it to leading smart home platforms, and provides one place to manage Matter connections over time, all within the Yale Access app.


Whether users prefer to control their lock through Yale Access or connect it to a Matter-compatible ecosystem, the updated experience provides greater flexibility and visibility from initial setup through everyday use.


[Learn more](https://shopyalehome.com/blogs/news-room/yale-simplifies-the-smart-home-experience-for-matter-enabled-smart-locks?_ab=0&_fd=0&_sc=1#slr-a60lebysr4rp) .
